correctness.rationale: In canonical regular-simplex coordinates the perpendicular foot on F_T is b_j + (sum omitted b)/|T| on T, zero elsewhere; positive b guarantees face-relative interior. Difference of vertex squared distances, with w_i=-2b_i, makes the clipped power cell the translated normal cone {x_i-b_i>=x_j-b_j}. Counting independently active tied-deviation or zero-coordinate facets yields exactly the 2^d foot vertices and cubical incidence; the cells tile P. A Dirichlet(1,...,1) section integral with inclusion-exclusion yields the displayed homogeneous subset polynomial. Equalizing any pair of other barycentric masses weakly enlarges its conditional centered interval overlap, strictly on a positive-measure set, proving strict Schur-concavity. Binomial identities give upper balanced equality, lower concentrated unattained endpoint and ratio tending e. Fresh direct exact rational flag-determinant volumes matched inclusion-exclusion for 60 cell cases in dimensions 2..4; the all-dimensional argument is analytic.

The surviving final claim derives every weight-dependent normalized volume fraction for arbitrary interior B, strict Schur majorization under fixed b_i, exact extrema and asymptotic e ratio.
